lock.standalone: Runs start from Metashape: open the project, then Tools > Run Script and choose start_in_metashape.py.
lock.viewing: An earlier run is only displayed and cannot be changed.
lock.running: Changes are locked during the run.
lock.finished: This run has ended. Start the script in Metashape again for a new run.
lock.model_missing: The files of the selected model are missing on this PC.
lock.model_invalid: The files of the selected model are incomplete or do not match.
lock.model_runtime: The packages of the selected model are missing. Please run install.bat again.
lock.classes: Your SAM 3 classes are invalid. Reset them on the Classes page or fix config/classes.user.yml.

overview.empty_hint: Metashape AI Classifier classifies the point cloud of the project that is open in Metashape.
overview.recent_empty: There are no earlier runs yet.

model.speed_note: Segmentation, measured in the SAMcloud drone test (approx. 2 s instead of 30 s per photo). Export, point voting and import do not get faster; the factor varies with the resolution.

flurseg.choice: 11 fixed classes, no prompts of your own.
flurseg.description: Our own model (EoMT-DINOv3) for drone photos of construction sites, roads and settlements. Default.
flurseg.accuracy: weaker than SAM 3 on thin classes
flurseg.missing: FlurSeg is not installed. Download the three files config.json, model.safetensors (1.26 GB) and preprocessor_config.json from the v1 folder and put them into this folder:

sam3.choice: Recognises your own classes through English prompts, but is much slower.
sam3.description: Meta SAM 3 looks for each class through text prompts. You can add classes of your own.
sam3.accuracy: more accurate than FlurSeg in the model test
sam3.missing: SAM 3 is not installed. It is only needed when SAM 3 is selected: request access from Meta and save sam3.pt here:
sam3.command: PowerShell command (after approval and hf auth login)

models.intro: Both models run locally. Only the selected model is needed.
models.manual_copy: The path is customised in the configuration. Copy the files there by hand.

estimate.unknown: Estimated run time: not available yet
estimate.windows_default: Estimate from {count} image windows at {rate} s per window (measured with fp32 on an RTX 4090), plus export and import.
estimate.windows_history: Estimate from {count} image windows and earlier FlurSeg runs of this project, plus export and import.
estimate.tiles_default: Estimate from {count} image tiles with a typical value for SAM 3, plus export and import.
estimate.tiles_history: Estimate from {count} image tiles and earlier SAM 3 runs of this project, plus export and import.

running.banner: The run continues even if this window is reloaded or closed. Please keep Metashape open.
running.export: Metashape is exporting the point cloud and cameras
running.import: Metashape is importing the classified point cloud
running.loading: Checking the geometry and loading the model …
running.first: The model is working on the first of {total} images …
running.finishing: All images are done. Computing post-filter and LAS …

cancel.locked: Cancelling is only possible during preparation and computation, not during export and import.

worker.running: This run's background process is still computing and occupies the GPU although Metashape no longer waits for it.

result.banner: Done. The point cloud “{label}” has been imported into Metashape. Metashape is the 3D view.
result.title: Classified points

failed.title: Classification failed
failed.hint: See the log for details. After fixing the cause, start the script in Metashape again.
failed.interrupted: The connection to the script in Metashape has ended. Metashape was closed or the script was aborted.

cancelled.banner: Cancelled. No classified point cloud was imported.
cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.hint: You can close this window. Start the script in Metashape again for a new run.

classes.fixed_reason: FlurSeg was trained on exactly these 11 classes. They are part of the weights and cannot be changed. Select SAM 3 for classes of your own.
classes.editable_reason: SAM 3 looks for each class through English prompts. Here you can adjust prompts, disable standard classes and add your own. These changes apply to SAM 3 only.
classes.own_empty: No classes of your own yet.
classes.reset_text: Your own classes, edited prompts and disabled classes will be lost.
classes.code_note: LAS code 1 means “unclassified”. Metashape imports only codes below 128.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.prompts_hint: Separate several prompts with commas, for example: manhole, manhole cover
dialog.code_hint: Free codes from 2 to 127 are allowed. An automatic code stays fixed afterwards.

class_error.name: “{name}” does not work: start with a letter, then use only letters, digits or underscores.
class_error.prompts: “{name}” needs at least one English prompt.
class_error.code_whole: The LAS code must be a whole number.
class_error.no_code: No free LAS code below 128 remains.
class_error.none_left: At least one class must stay enabled.
class_error.file: The class file {path} cannot be read: {detail}

profile.custom_hint: Custom: the values match no profile.
profile.flurseg_fast: Long image side 3200 px. Fastest; thin classes (curb, marking, utility cover) suffer most.
profile.flurseg_balanced: Long image side 4000 px, as in SAMcloud. Thin classes lose some accuracy on very large photos.
profile.flurseg_accurate: Original resolution, as the model card recommends. Most accurate for thin classes.
profile.sam3_fast: 50 % image resolution, 10 % overlap, 1 observation per point.
profile.sam3_balanced: 75 % image resolution, 20 % overlap, 1 observation per point.
profile.sam3_accurate: 100 % image resolution, 30 % overlap, 2 observations per point.

settings.standalone: The settings of a run appear when the app is started from Metashape. The defaults are in config/default.yml.
settings.profile_hint: The choice applies to this run only. config/default.yml stays unchanged.
settings.flurseg_hint: 768 px windows with half overlap. If GPU memory runs short, the window batch is halved automatically.
settings.sam_hint: 1008 px tiles. More prompts per pass are faster but need more GPU memory.
settings.auto_done: Chose {batch} prompts per pass ({free} of {total} GiB GPU memory free). Metashape and the PC may respond slowly.
settings.assists_hint: They decide only where the model leaves a point unknown.
settings.filters_hint: Cleanup of the point cloud after voting.
settings.vegetation: Split vegetation by height above terrain
settings.expert_hint: Thresholds are shares between 0 and 1. Normally leave them as they are.
settings.min_share: Minimum share of the winning class
settings.interior: Distance to the mask edge in pixels
settings.language_hint: Applies to the whole app and is saved.

log.hint: Live log of the app and the background process.

error.worker_gone: The background process is no longer running.
error.worker_alive: The background process could not be stopped. Please end it in the Task Manager.
error.classes_file: The class file is invalid. Please reset it to standard.
error.no_gpu_info: Free GPU memory cannot be read. The current value stays.
error.no_safe_batch: Only {free} GiB of GPU memory free: no safe value found. Please close other GPU applications.
